div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
TrueTime sets commit timestamp with bounded uncertainty
Wait for commit: TT.now().latest - TT.now().earliest
Typically 1-7ms wait for clock uncertainty

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
- Reads from any replica that has applied up to timestamp
- Bounded staleness reads: 0-10s stale, very fast
- Strong reads: go through leader, returns latest
